headline: Nifty Eyes 23,600 Resistance as Markets Rebound on Easing Crude and Metal Sector Gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Easing crude oil prices and hopes of West Asia de-escalation supported the market rebound.
Strong performance in metal and realty sectors led the gains on the previous trading day.
Technical analysis indicates Nifty faces a key resistance level at 23,600 in a rangebound market.
Positive cues from Gift Nifty and Asian markets are providing direction for the current session.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty 50 recovered on September 23, with Nifty closing above the 23,400 mark.
Sensex has slipped over 11,000 points from its record high over the last ten months.
Trade bodies have called for a 'No UPI Day' on October 2 to protest MDR levies.
NSE shares are set to trade on the Metropolitan Stock Exchange in addition to the BSE.
summary:
Indian markets showed a rebound on September 23, led by metal and realty stocks amid easing crude oil prices. Nifty faces key resistance at 23,600 as it remains rangebound despite the recent recovery.
Investors are watching global cues and potential de-escalation in West Asia for further market direction.
